cmd:
set -e
B=claude/direct-automation-expeditor-671esy
cd /root/Iryna_Karmazina && git fetch -q origin $B
cp /root/unitex-os-www/index.html /root/unitex-os-www/index.html.bak-inline
git show origin/$B:www/index.html > /root/unitex-os-www/index.html
echo "editCell: $(grep -c 'editCell' /root/unitex-os-www/index.html)"
echo "data-ed: $(grep -o 'data-ed=' /root/unitex-os-www/index.html | wc -l)"
echo "edit:true у ролях: $(grep -o 'edit:true' /root/unitex-os-www/index.html | wc -l)"
IP=$(curl -s -4 ifconfig.me); echo "UI $(curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' https://$IP/)"
